title: Phone Numbers
subtitle: Manage your Twilio and SIP phone numbers for outbound campaigns and inbound calls.

alerts.aiNotConfiguredBody: Deepgram, ElevenLabs, and OpenRouter are required for AI calling to work.
alerts.twilioNotConfiguredBody: You need to configure your Twilio SID and Token in Settings before you can use Twilio numbers.

list.title: Connected Numbers
list.description: Your phone numbers linked to Twilio or SIP trunks, ready for outbound campaigns and inbound calls.
list.emptyDescription: Add your first phone number (Twilio or SIP) to start making AI voice calls.

twilioInfo.title: Twilio Inbound Calling
twilioInfo.body: To receive inbound calls via Twilio, point your Twilio phone number's "A Call Comes In" webhook to:
twilioInfo.afterCode: Once pointed, any call to your number will automatically be handled by the assigned Inbound Agent.

sipInfo.title: SIP Trunk Calling
sipInfo.body: For local numbers (e.g. Saudi +966), create a SIP Trunk first with your carrier's credentials, then add a phone number here and select "SIP Trunk" as the provider. Calls will be routed through Asterisk, no Twilio needed.
sipInfo.originationBody: To receive inbound calls on SIP trunk numbers, set this as the Origination URI in your provider's dashboard:

dialog.description: Configure your phone number, choose a provider, and assign an inbound agent.
dialog.noTrunks: No SIP trunks found. Go to SIP Trunks page to create one first.
dialog.selectAgent: Select an agent for inbound calls
dialog.inboundAgentHint: Incoming calls to this number will be handled by the selected agent.
dialog.fallbackHint: If no agent is assigned, inbound calls will be forwarded to this number instead of hanging up.
